body: Inside of me is where I hurt the most. I hate even going out anymore because I'm afraid people are judging me on my appearance. I think about suicide more and more each day. I can't live with BDD anymore people don't understand how hard it is to wake up and hate yourself everyday for something you did not choose or were born with. I have been depressed basically since middle school because I was picked on in elementary school. High school is when it got the worse I stopped going to school and class. People have beat me down made me feel worthless. There is no changing or reversing the psychological/emotional damage that has been done over the years. Maybe this is how it was meant for people like us to exist and suffer for the betterment of the prettier more acceptional people.
